subject: CMS February 25, 2026 Minnesota Medicaid deferral
findings: CMS deferred $259,505,491 in federal matching funds on February 25, 2026.
Minnesota's federal lawsuit challenges the approximately $243.8 million program-integrity portion of the deferral; the approximately $15.4 million immigration-status component is distinct.
On April 6, 2026, the district court denied Minnesota's request for temporary/preliminary injunctive relief.

The court characterized the deferral as an ongoing administrative inquiry rather than a final disallowance and emphasized that CMS had not yet made a final allowability decision on the questioned claims.
CMS's March 19 approval of Minnesota's corrective action plan did not itself terminate or release the deferral; the court treated those processes separately.
As of August 29, the Minnesota Attorney General's litigation tracker continues to list the CMS deferral lawsuit with the preliminary-injunction denial as its current status.
publication_rule: Do not describe the $259.5M as fraud proven, money permanently lost, money returned, or a resolved dispute. The presently supported description is a federal funding deferral under ongoing administrative review, with Minnesota's challenge to the program-integrity component still in litigation after denial of preliminary relief.
open_questions: Whether CMS has made any final allowability/disallowance determinations for the sampled or questioned claims.
Whether any portion of the $259,505,491 has since been released, adjusted, or converted into a final disallowance.
Current docket filings after the April 6 preliminary-injunction order and any schedule for merits adjudication.
Disposition of the separate approximately $15.4M immigration-status component.
